newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pharmaceutical distributor API to list on ASX.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pharmaceutical distributor API to list on ASX.

text.p: Wholesale pharmaceutical distributor Australian Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd (API) said on Thursday it would seek a compliance listing of its shares on the Australian Stock Exchange.
The company said in a statement it was the third largest operator in the Australian wholesale pharmaceutical industry, with annual sales of more than A$800 million.
The proposed listing would be subject to approval by the company's 2,400 pharmacist member shareholders, it said.

"The proposed compliance listing will give a full market value, in excess of the current par value of A$1.00 per share, on shareholder members' investment in ordinary shares," chairman John Matthews said.
